methods.name: Completed UTC equal-window comparisons
methods.definition: Current and immediately preceding windows have the same count of consecutive completed UTC dates. Missing financial fields invalidate financial outputs; optional counts retain null and suppress count-derived statistics.

methods.name: Currency-consistent capture
methods.definition: sum(captured USD receipts) / sum(accrued USD gross fees), separate from native-NEAR ratio. This is a period cash/accrual capture measure, not cohort retention or verified partner payout.

methods.name: Exact symmetric accounting attribution
methods.interpretation: Both replacement orders are averaged. Contributions reconcile exactly to the change in observed receipts. Descriptive accounting, not causal identification.

methods.name: Burst sensitivity
methods.definition: Median daily volume and share of period volume occurring on the five largest days. No winsorization or suppression of revenue sweeps.

references.title: Attributing Differences Between Forecast Runs to Input Changes, With Applications to CCAR and CECL Exercises
references.use: Exact order-independent attribution principle; adapted to observed volume times realized receipts rate. Not a NEAR valuation or forecast.
